stem.alt: compound Z: cyclohexane ring with HO and CO2H on one carbon, OH groups on two other ring carbons, and a but-2-enoate ester (CH3CH=CHCO2-) on a further ring carbon
stem.label: compound Z

stem.text: What is produced in good yield when compound Z is treated with an excess of sodium carbonate solution at room temperature?

A.alt: Z with the CO2H converted to CO2Na; ring OH groups unchanged; but-2-enoate ester retained

B.alt: ring with NaO and CO2Na on one carbon, NaO and ONa on ring carbons; but-2-enoate ester retained

C.alt: ring with NaO and CO2H on one carbon, NaO and ONa on ring carbons; but-2-enoate ester retained

D.alt: ring with HO and CO2Na on one carbon and OH groups on three other ring carbons; no ester
